notes: The manual offers two alternative sensor circuits (potentiometer or 10k photoresistor + 10k resistor divider). I built the first, potentiometer circuit (outer pins to GND and 5V, wiper to A0); the photoresistor variant was not built.

The optional external LED circuit (pin 13 -> 220 ohm resistor -> red LED anode, cathode -> GND next to pin 13) is included, placed on the breadboard in columns 20-25 with two jumper wires; the built-in LED on pin 13 can be used instead. GND.3 is assumed to be the GND pin beside pin 13.

In the potentiometer image the yellow wire appears to end at the far side of the board gap above the pot body; electrically it must reach the pot's middle (wiper) pin, so it is placed in the same strip (11t) as the middle leg.
The potentiometer legs sit in row e of columns 10-12 (GND, SIG, VCC); black and red wires are in row d of columns 10 and 12 (breadboard half nearest the bottom of the image mapped to bank 't').
